Financial: This clause creates unlimited or uncapped financial exposure for a party.
This clause imposes a significant monetary penalty or liquidated damages.
This clause requires immediate or accelerated payment obligations.
Legal: This clause imposes broad or one-sided indemnification obligations.
This clause allows termination without cause or without notice.
This clause requires a party to waive significant legal rights.
Compliance: This clause imposes regulatory or statutory compliance obligations.
This clause is governed by a specific jurisdiction's laws and courts.
This clause requires adherence to sanctions or anti-corruption regulations.
Operational: This clause imposes tight deadlines or short notice periods.
This clause creates dependencies on multiple other obligations or milestones.
This clause requires ongoing service level or delivery commitments.
